symbols.reasoning: Checks run-independent withdrawal key replay, closed-set external-capital source, positive amount and reason. Resolves actor and validates treasury_manage or issued fallback approval. Requires open business day, begins transaction then obtains protected-source movement lock before spending validation. Journal, outward movement, audit and completed key commit atomically. Attribution uses returned approval, unlike CloseShift FIN017. Conflict rollback returns saved replay, with sibling retry only for contention. Transaction-held lock is stronger than OpenShift/ReceivePurchase FIN011; no observed negative-balance race established for this path.
